title: National VFW Day is a good time to thank the veterans you know
dek: Today is National VFW Day, which honors the Veterans of Foreign Wars and the veterans who keep their local posts going.
body: Today is National VFW Day, which honors the Veterans of Foreign Wars. Many towns have a VFW post, and in a lot of places it is one of the steady gathering spots for veterans and their families.

I think many of us drive past those buildings without thinking much about them. Inside, veterans are often doing quiet work. They help each other with paperwork and benefits, organize events and simply keep each other company.

Most of us know at least one veteran, whether it is a grandparent, a neighbor or a coworker. We may thank them on holidays in November, but an ordinary Tuesday evening can be a good time, too, because it catches them by surprise.
A thank you does not need to be big. A short message that says you are grateful and are thinking of them is enough. If they want to share a story, listen. If they do not, that is fine as well.
Before you go to bed tonight, send a note to one veteran in your life. Keep it short and sincere.
